task.title: Close the .gitignore markdown blanket-ignore silent-drop gap for docs/ and infra/

problem.statement: .gitignore line 6 (`**/*.md`) blanket-ignores every markdown file repo-wide and was only negated for governance/, .agents/, and tools/remediation/ (plus a handful of individually named files). docs/ and infra/ had no negation, so any new markdown file placed there silently never got tracked, with no error from git or any guard. Two real, substantive, pre-existing documents were confirmed lost from history as a result.

evidence.note: Blanket **/*.md with no negation for docs/ or infra/ before this fix.
Existed on disk since 2026-07-15 with zero git history (`git log --all` returns nothing) until this task tracked it.
Existed on disk since 2026-07-14 with zero git history until this task tracked it.

rootCauseHypothesis: The governance/.agents/tools-remediation negation pattern was applied only to directories touched by the progressive remediation build itself; docs/ and infra/ markdown was never audited against the blanket ignore rule, so files placed there by other work silently never entered git history.

current: New markdown files under docs/ or infra/ are silently ignored by git with no warning from any guard.
required: Markdown files under docs/ and infra/ are tracked by default (negated out of the blanket **/*.md ignore), while binary/generated exclusions in the same directories are unaffected; both previously-hidden documents are tracked.
forbidden: Deleting docs/MIGRATION_SAFETY.md or infra/docker/PRODUCTION_ARCHITECTURE.md without confirming they are superseded (neither carries a retired/obsolete/superseded status marker).
Blanket-untracking .gitignore's markdown rule without auditing what else it currently hides.

acceptance.statement: .gitignore no longer silently drops new markdown files under docs/ or infra/, while binary/generated exclusions in those directories still apply.
docs/MIGRATION_SAFETY.md and infra/docker/PRODUCTION_ARCHITECTURE.md are tracked in git.
A repo-wide audit of git-ignored paths found no other substantive silently-dropped document beyond these two.
